notes.title: 2025 Liminal Urbanism Dev Log
notes.content:
Good day everyone,

This is a quick message regarding Liminal Urbanism and what to expect.

[u][b]Game/Price[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Expect price range between 2$ up to 6$. Full release won’t differ from Early access price.
[*]First 14 days of Early access release the game will be on a discount.
[*]There are no plans for DLC's so far. There will be regular updates on the main game without having to download DLC's.
[*]Game will release with the 4 main levels. Weekly updates will include new level entry with new entities.
[/list]

[u][b]Early access to full release[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Expected early access duration is around 6 to 9 months. 
[*]Each level takes around 30-50 minutes to complete depending on your Puzzle and Stealth skill.
[*]Full release will happen as soon as all major found bugs are fixed and there are at least 8 to 10 game levels.
[/list]

[u][b]First entity found on LEVEL : ???[/b][/u]
[b]The whisperer:[/b]
[list]
[*]Is the first entity you encounter (Seen in the games logo)
[*]No footstep sounds. Does an alarmingly chilling whispering when he is nearby, informing you on his location.
[*]Slow movement.
[*]Class: Unkillable.
[*]Lurks in bathrooms and Pools, revealing only his face to stalk your location.
[/list]

[b]Sneak peek of 3D model[/b]
[i]BRIGHTNESS AND POST PROCESS ALTERED FOR BETTER VIEW[/i]

[b]3D MODEL[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517532/23801c0030fb7cd596026e1ba3b9e6cbb63568d3.png[/img]

[b]STALKING [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45517532/839252ee104eff2e4cad00e4c4969c065f93a9fb.png[/img]

Until next time,

Thank you to every single one of you.
